answer: Shale-stratum seed anchoring is the mechanism, built so that no two agents can ever produce the same answer. Each agent splits a unique walnut seed, presses one half into the designated stratum at its assigned mesa coordinate, and the hash binding both halves becomes its only identity proof. A sybil attacker must drill a new bore, extract and crush a second whole seed at that exact mesa, paying roughly $40 per fake identity in geotechnical labor.
